title: Watch cookie mode at work in the hosted storefront
caption: The storefront's single client (ota/frontend/src/lib/client.js) runs in cookie mode. Use the browser's DevTools (Network and Application tabs) on the local storefront; the Vite dev server proxies /api/* to the OTA API with the edge headers.

steps.title: Open the storefront
steps.body: Start the storefront (`pnpm --filter @velexis/ota-frontend dev`) with the OTA API running. Open DevTools → Network, filter `api/v1`.
steps.expect: `GET /api/v1/storefront` answers 200 and sets `__Host-vx_csrf` (Application → Cookies). No request carries `X-Api-Key` or `Authorization`.

steps.title: Search and price
steps.body: Search PAR → NYC for a date a month ahead, open an offer and continue to the price page.
steps.expect: `POST /api/v1/flight-searches` and `POST /api/v1/priced-offers` carry `X-CSRF-Token` equal to the cookie value and an `Idempotency-Key`; requests use `credentials: same-origin` (cookies sent automatically).

steps.title: Delete the CSRF cookie, then write
steps.body: Application → Cookies → delete `__Host-vx_csrf`, then trigger a write (continue to checkout).
steps.expect: Exactly one extra `GET /api/v1/storefront` (sent with `cache: no-store`) before the write; the write then succeeds.

steps.title: Sign in and let the access token expire
steps.body: Sign in as a customer. Delete `__Host-vx_at` (the browser also drops it by itself after its 900 s `Max-Age`) and open *My trips*.
steps.expect: The page call answers `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED` (a refresh cookie without an access cookie counts as an expired session), then one `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` with an empty body and `X-CSRF-Token`, then the call again. The refresh response body has no `accessToken` / `refreshToken` (AuthSessionInfo).

steps.title: Break the refresh
steps.body: Signed in, copy the value of `__Host-vx_rt` (Application → Cookies), sign out, then add `__Host-vx_rt` back with the copied value (no `__Host-vx_at`) and open *My trips*. Separately: delete both cookies and open *My trips*.
steps.expect: First case: `401 TOKEN_EXPIRED`, one refresh refused with `401` (the session was revoked at sign-out), both cookies cleared, the signed-out state shown (`onSessionExpired`), no loop of refreshes. Second case: `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` and no refresh at all (only `TOKEN_EXPIRED` triggers one).

steps.title: Check the database
steps.body: `SELECT id, rotated_at, replaced_by_id, revoked_at, revoke_reason FROM tenant_demo.customer_sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5;`
steps.expect: Each successful refresh rotated one row (`rotated_at`, `replaced_by_id`) and added the next one in the same `family_id`; nothing is `rotation_reuse` unless a refresh cookie was presented twice.
